brief: A herb planter of three cells side by side, each with a bin that drains.

requirements.evidence: piece:0,0,0;full at q0, piece:1,0,0;full at q1, piece:2,0,0;full at q2 form continuous row, joined with joint bolts

requirements.requirement: Each cell with a bin that drains
requirements.evidence: bin:0,0,0~hex-bin-full-drain, bin:1,0,0~hex-bin-full-drain, bin:2,0,0~hex-bin-full-drain - all three are Bin full depth drained

finish.summary: Built three full hex bases at 0,0,0 / 1,0,0 / 2,0,0 side by side along q, each fitted with hex-bin-full-drain for drainage. Joint-bolted for stability, meshClash clear.

lines.label: M6 x 25 socket head screw, ISO 4762

notes: Tighten every M6 to 2 N.m: HAND TOOLS ONLY, never a cordless driver. These bolts clamp printed PETG, not metal: at the bolt's own 10.4 N.m rating the head crushes the plastic under it and the joint fails silently, looking tight while holding nothing. Snug, then a nudge. Re-check the bolts after the first few weeks: PETG relaxes under load and the clamp will have eased.
